class DonationStatus(Enum):

    RECEIVED = "Received"
    PROCESSING = "Processing"
    FAILED = "Failed"

class CampaignStatus(Enum):

    ACTIVE = "Active"
    COMPLETED = "Completed"
    CANCELLED = "Cancelled"

class AppealType(Enum):
